title: Einstein's cosmological constant and cosmic antigravity

tellings.quote: Einstein liked the idea that the universe never expanded because then you don't have to imagine what was there before the beginning.

plain: In 1917 Einstein added a term to his equations, the cosmological constant, a kind of cosmic antigravity that let the universe stay the same size forever. The Harvard astronomer Avi Loeb tells Michels that Einstein liked a universe that never expanded "because then you don't have to imagine what was there before the beginning."
